messages:
Nina: Small request for runtime: marketing needs a tight, reproducible spot-check to support a short-input latency claim for the launch post.

Nina: Spec: models = redwood/santa-13b, redwood/santa-13b-int8, redwood/santa-13b-int4; 40 samples/variant; warmup 8 prefixes; seed=31415; measure server-side end-to-end latency; report median/p95/p99 + 8 raw prompt->response pairs per variant; annotate cache hits.

Diego: Hosted catalog OK. We'll run main (max_tokens=150) then a short follow-up (max_tokens=50, 20 samples/variant) if numbers miss the target. Upload to gs://redwood-marketing/spotcheck-5098765432/.

bench-bot: Job created job_id=spotcheck-5098765432, ETA ~20m.

Diego: Main run: stable median=138ms, p95=300ms, p99=440ms, cache_hit~82%. Uploading artifacts.

Nina: 138ms > 120ms target. Run short-input follow-up please.

Diego: Short-input results: stable median=99ms, p95=205ms, p99=345ms; int8 median=86ms; int4 median=80ms. Artifacts at gs://redwood-marketing/spotcheck-5098765432/ (CSV, raw JSONs, README with seed/warmup/cache flags).

Priya: Quick quality check: short-input outputs look consistent across variants. A couple int4 long-context runs showed mild truncation; flagged in README.

Nina: Great. Drafting a 1-paragraph caveat for launch: "On short inputs (seeded sample, n=20), median latency = 99ms for stable; full-run medians are higher; see artifacts (link) for details." THANKS.
